definition: מִפְלֶ֫צֶת noun feminine horrid thing (thing to shudder at ); — לַאֲשֵׁרָה ׳ עָֽשְׂתָה מ 1Kgs 15:13 (of some abominable object of idolatry, not precisely known), so suffix מִפְלַצְתָּהּ v 1Kgs 15:13 = 2Chr 15:16 (twice in verse).
